title: andreassag/janus samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the CSV samplesheet provided via --input.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file path must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have a valid FASTA extension (.fa, .fas, .fna, .fasta, optionally .gz).

complete.errorMessage: The 'complete' column must be a boolean ('true' or 'false') when specified.

gram.errorMessage: The 'gram' column must be '+', '-', or '?' when specified.

locus_prefix.errorMessage: The 'locus_prefix' column cannot contain spaces or special characters (allowed: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_', '.', '-').
